manifest.name: Claude Code
manifest.description: Claude Code usage (5-hour session and week, across every Windows and WSL account) and approval of permission prompts right in the ring

show_usage.name: Claude · Session (5h)
show_usage.description: Claude Code 5-hour session usage, right on the button. Click to refresh and see the details in a notification.

usage_gauge.name: Claude · Week
usage_gauge.description: Claude Code weekly usage, right on the button. Click to refresh and see the details in a notification.

approve.name: Claude · Approve
approve.description: Approves the oldest Claude Code permission prompt. The button lights up while a prompt is waiting.

decline.name: Claude · Decline
decline.description: Declines the oldest Claude Code permission prompt.

dyn.name: Claude · {tier} · {account}
dyn.descSession: 5-hour session usage of the Claude Code account in {account}.
dyn.descWeek: Weekly usage of the Claude Code account in {account}.

hook.denied: Declined by the user in OrbitRing.
hook.badJson: {file} is not valid JSON ({error}) — nothing was changed.
hook.notObject: {file} does not hold a JSON object — nothing was changed.
hook.hooksNotObject: "hooks" in {file} is not an object — nothing was changed.
hook.eventNotList: "hooks.{event}" in {file} is not a list — nothing was changed.
hook.removed: Hook removed. It applies to the next Claude Code sessions.
hook.installed: Hook installed. Open a new Claude Code session (or check /hooks) for it to apply.

simulate.serviceOk: Approval service OK at http://127.0.0.1:{port} — {count} pending request(s).
simulate.instructions: Look at the notice next to the cursor, open the ring and pick Approve or Decline (60 s)…
simulate.noAnswer: NO ANSWER (ask) — Claude Code would show its usual prompt in the terminal
